newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Roly expects to improve performance.
newsitem.headline: Roly expects to improve performance.

text.p: Home decor firm Roly International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it expects to perform better in the current financial year ending April 1998.
In a statement accompanying its financial results for the year ended April 1997, the group said cost-cutting efforts were expected to enhance profit contributions from the U.S. and Europe.
The group also said higher profits were expected from its Asian activities.
The group announced a 52.9 percent slip in net profit for the year ended April 1997 to US$7.75 million while turnover rose to US$247.19 million from US$238.33 million.
